name: BrowserGym Ecosystem
description: BrowserGym is a unified, gym-like environment for standardized evaluation of web agents, providing well-defined observation and action spaces. The extended ecosystem unifies existing web agent benchmarks and includes AgentLab for agent creation, testing, and analysis, enabling consistent evaluation and comprehensive experiment management.
reputation: BrowserGym is increasingly used as a standard evaluation environment for web agents, especially for reproducible benchmarking across multiple tasks.
notes: Includes multiple existing benchmarks unified under one ecosystem; supports large-scale multi-benchmark experiments comparing state-of-the-art LLMs on web agent tasks.
